chunks: I heard Yūnus ibn Ya‘qūb, from Sinān ibn Ṭarīf, from Abī ‘Abdillāh (عليه السلام).
He says, he said: We are the first Ahl al-Bayt whose names Allah proclaimed.
Indeed, when He created the heavens and the earth, He commanded a caller, and he called out:
I testify that there is no god except Allah, three times; I testify that Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allah, three times; I testify that ‘Alī is truly the Commander of the Faithful, three times.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, the title of ‘Alī عليه السلام
key_terms.أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ: the Household, referring here to the blessed family of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: Messenger of Allah, referring to Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.مُنَادِيًا: a caller commissioned to make a proclamation
key_terms.نَوَّهَ: proclaimed, exalted, or made widely known

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the names of the Ahl al-Bayt being proclaimed at creation?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes a primordial proclamation of tawhid, the messengership of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and the true authority of ‘Alī عليه السلام at the time of the creation of the heavens and the earth. It presents the Ahl al-Bayt as specially named and divinely announced, emphasizing their rank and theological significance.

en.hubeali: Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Waleed who said, ‘I heard Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from Sinan Bin Tareyf,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘We<sup>asws</sup> were the first family Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Commended by our<sup>asws</sup> names.
It was that when He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the skies and the earth, He<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded a Caller to Call out:

‘I testify that there is no god except for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, thrice, and, ‘I testify that Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> is Rasool<sup>as</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, thrice, and, ‘I testify that Ali<sup>asws</sup> is Amir Al-Momineen truly’, thrice’.
en.sarwar: 8. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Walid who has said that he heard Yunus ibn ya‘qub narrated from Sinan ibn Turayf who has said the following. “I heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say, ‘
We are the first family whose names Allah has exalted.
When He created the heavens and earth He commanded an announcer to proclaim.

“I testify that there is no lord besides Allah three times. I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, three times and that Ali is the Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) (Leader with Divine Authority) in all truth, three times.”
